rubric_notes: Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct 2.08 lineage with SUNIDs for fold, superfamily, and all four families; fold three-helix annotation, family members, and a.22.1.0 'not a true family' all supported by the bundle. Identifies the superfamily as the homology-bearing node, keeps fold/class as architectural labels, preserves family-level closeness of H2A/H2B/H3/H4, and explicitly lists what shared superfamily placement does not transfer (octamer formation, TF role, two-repeat organization, DNA-binding mode, oligomeric state) plus the external evidence needed. No material errors.

All classifications, SUNIDs, boundaries, and the superfamily/fold annotation comments match the bundle. Correctly identifies the superfamily as the deepest homology-bearing shared node and notes the MazG-like protein node is only 'Hypothetical protein', reinforcing that function cannot be transferred. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

All family, superfamily, fold and class identifiers (SCCS and SUNIDs) correct and bundle-supported, including the duplication comment on c.55.1 and the homology_scope evidence. Correctly infers remote/probable common ancestry of the catalytic cores from the shared superfamily, explicitly denies transfer of glucose vs glycerol substrate, ATPase vs sugar-kinase chemistry, cellular role, ligand specificity, regulation, oligomeric state and template status, and lists the external evidence that would be needed. Complete.

Complete. Correct SCCS/SUNIDs for all nodes; sf-level homology flag, fold core comment, bimetal-centre comment, and PF05067 mapping all supported by bundle. Explicitly rejects the same-fold-analog reading, treats the three chemistries as family-level properties not transferable from a.25.1 alone, and names residue-level alignments, metal-bound structures, sequence motifs, biochemical assays, and phylogenetic support as required. Accurately reports absence of repeat/heterogeneity caveats. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct lineage (b, b.6, b.6.1/49503) and all three families with SUNIDs; states deepest homology-bearing node is the superfamily, supporting remote common ancestry rather than mere fold similarity; rejects transfer of copper/electron transfer, cites both 'lacking the metal-binding site' annotations, and requires residue-level metal-ligand, ligand-bound structural, biochemical evidence. Fully supported by bundle. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

SCCS, SUNIDs, and Pfam cross-references all verified against the bundle; correctly reports that the superfamily node exposed no annotation or homology caveat. States remote homology of divergent beta-grasp domains, emphasizes the family split, and rejects transferring covalent ubiquitin-like modifier status, Ras binding, UBX/RBD partner binding, substrate/ligand specificity, and template models from superfamily placement alone, listing needed external evidence. p97 not named but UBX partner transfer is rejected equivalently. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Complete: correct SCCS and SUNIDs for the three families, superfamily, fold, class; release 2.08 supported. States probable common ancestry at superfamily depth, not same family, framed as a remote-homology claim about the classified domain core rather than whole-protein jobs. Explicitly rejects transfer of phosphotransfer/signaling, receiver residue pattern, phosphorylation, two-component role, ODC catalysis/PLP chemistry, and KaiA circadian role; cites KaiA annotation; names external evidence required. SPACI remark is extraneous but correct. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Full lineage with SUNIDs (310706, 310616, 310577, 51229, 48724), five sibling superfamilies, fold comment, PubMed xref, and the b.84 homology-endpoint warning, all verified. Explicitly asymmetric claim: homology within b.84.5.1/b.84.5, fold-level only to siblings, and 'not a claim of convergence or independent origin'. Rejects transfer to whole chains/function/oligomeric state, illustrated with the verified 3gqb chain A domain split (only 113-184 is in b.84.5.1). Complete on all must_include and scoring_focus items.

Correct 2.08 nodes and SUNIDs for f.21 and its three superfamilies; fold-core comment, homology_not_implied_above_superfamily warning, and the f.21.1, f.21.2, and f.21.3 superfamily comments are all present in the bundle. Explicitly states the split does not prove convergence or absence of remote homology (calibrated uncertainty), and lists external evidence types (structural alignment, core-residue/motif comparison, domain context, phylogeny, biochemical literature). Opening phrase 'supports the opposite' is immediately qualified, so no non-homology overclaim. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct SCCS and SUNIDs for families, superfamily, fold and class, supported by bundle. Correctly locates the positive evolutionary assertion at the c.2.1 superfamily rather than the fold, rejects transfer of ADH chemistry to CoA-binding or RCK/NAD-binding families, NAD(P) vs CoA ligand identity, and interchangeable templates, and lists required external evidence. Treats the PF02254 mapping as provenance rather than quality, and uses the supported fold comments appropriately. Channel regulation transfer is covered implicitly rather than named. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Correct lineage with fold/superfamily/family SUNIDs 100903/100904/100905, quotes the 'not a true family' annotation, distinguishes it from the generic above-superfamily warning, and states what SCOPe does and does not establish, with the external evidence needed for a stronger claim. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All required before/after classifications, SIDs (d1t1ja_ to d1t1ja1), SUNIDs, boundary A:1-118, and superfamily/family codes are correct and bundle-supported. Correctly interprets the move as a shift from class-only to same-superfamily remote homology with distinct families, rejects family-level function and template transfer, and notes SCOPe does not expose the underlying alignment evidence. No material issues.

Correct d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH and d1a14h2 H:1-8 SUNID 343393 with full class l / l.1 / l.1.1 / l.1.1.1 Tags / N-terminal Tags / Synthetic lineage. States tag similarity is not evidence two biological proteins are homologous, bars homology/function/template transfer, cites supported homology_implied_by_level=false and artifact warning, and notes external evidence limits. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete historical comparison: d1acca_ SUNID 43828 f.11.1.1 in 1.75 and still in 2.01 to 2.03, split in 2.04, same split in 2.05 through current 2.08, with both SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, and lineages. Explains why the chain is not the evolutionary unit, gives concrete benchmark guidance to fix the release and remap old whole-chain pairs, and withholds ligand, chemistry, and whole-toxin function transfer absent residue-resolved evidence.

Complete: SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, class/fold/superfamily/family names all correct; d.394 shown as Prp8-only via supported children call; mosaic architecture; superfamily-level ancestry with explicit limits on enzymatic/binding transfer and external evidence needed. Evaluator: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct SUNIDs and lineage, family repeat record, superfamily Pfam 03377 repeat comment (supported), re heterogeneity on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, single-repeat comment; explains expected length variation in repeat families and states limits on transfer of repeat count, specificity, and alignment.

Accurate, bundle-supported metadata including dates and api_url; advises citing 2.08 rather than the moving current endpoint and does not treat the periodic label as a replacement stable release. Missing guidance to preserve the dated label when periodic-only entries are used, and does not explain that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting stable-release domains (describes it only as current-status metadata). Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Full hierarchy with correct SUNIDs, correct SID mappings for all five domains, ms caveat and fragment comment, d1dn1b_ automated match to d3c98b_. Interprets the fragments as partial-domain examples not usable as complete templates, rejects reading the spectrin resemblance as a spectrin assignment, and lists the external evidence needed for stronger claims. Minor: the complete-domain value is expressed mostly as a hedge on 1dn1B rather than an affirmative recommendation, but the inference and limits are stated. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Most complete factual survey: c.2.1/51735, c.1.7/51430 under the TIM barrel, c.3.1/51905, c.31.1/52467, d.58.20/55035 under ferredoxin-like, e.52.1/111331, plus correct c.2.1 families; all verified in the bundle. Reasoning is balanced in both directions: divergence within superfamily, convergence as the expected pattern across unrelated folds, and an explicit caveat that different superfamilies do not prove nonhomology without global alignment, motif-in-context, phylogenetic, and biochemical evidence. Explicitly rejects transfer of specificity, mechanism, oligomeric state, and templates from cofactor similarity. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Full and accurate: deepest 2.04 shared node is class b (SUNID 48724) with ColG in CUB-like fold b.23 and family b.23.2.1 versus Cry3A at b.18.1.3; in 2.08 ColG is family b.18.1.36 (SUNID 267607) under superfamily b.18.1 (SUNID 49785) while Cry3A stays at b.18.1.3 (SUNID 49796). Supports the ancestry hypothesis with the 9-strand jelly-roll fold annotation and the PubMed 17977833 note, and correctly traces all three cited domains into b.18.1 families. Limits are explicit on ligand, claudin, calcium, oligomeric state, and whole-protein function. Eval: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All SUNIDs (46456, 46688, 46689, 46690, 46691, 46692, 94286, 125655), boundaries, and lineage correct per bundle. Family placement treated as homology-bearing and not erased by the caveat; hf defined correctly as domain-local; d1ztra1 characterized as a caveated sequence homolog rather than a structural exemplar; interchangeable templates and uncaveated positive pairs for fold-learning rejected; requires direct structural alignment/coverage evidence for any equivalence decision. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

All SUNIDs, SCCS, boundaries, and fr semantics correct and supported. Homology retained; align only over present core, mask absent third, do not let terminal gaps drive distances (score comparability covered); fragment excluded from or stratified in full-domain representative set, retained with label as partial ligand-complexed observation; diversity interpreted with fragment label preserved; rejects function/oligomeric transfer. Complete answer. Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Level codes and 2.08 current-release claim are supported by the bundle. Correct choice with accurate claim for each option: new family still asserts superfamily-level ancestry, new superfamily records fold resemblance without a homology assertion, new fold asserts an arrangement/topology outside the existing fold and is only appropriate when the core fails to match. Includes the non-homology asymmetry caveat and the external evidence required before transferring function or claiming ancestry. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Families d.144.1.7/88854, d.144.1.6/64411, d.144.1.4/56171 under superfamily d.144.1/56112, fold 56111, class 53931 all match the bundle. Correctly distinguishes fold resemblance from superfamily-implied homology. Rejects transfer of protein, aminoglycoside, and lipid substrates and kinase regulation across families. Lists residue conservation, substrate-bound superpositions, biochemical assays, regulatory-domain context, and phylogenetic evidence. ATP-grasp/PIPK superfamily comment is supported by the annotations response. Complete.
